nodes.name: power_5v
nodes.description: TPS54331 buck converter steps VIN_12V down to VCC_5V. EN pin configuration determines enable policy (tie to VIN for always-on or GPIO for controlled enable). BOOT pin requires bootstrap capacitor to PH pin. VSENSE pin sets output voltage via resistor divider to GND. COMP pin requires compensation network for loop stability. SS pin controls soft-start timing. This module is the VCC_5V distribution hub for stepper driver logic supplies and the 3.3V LDO input.
Motor power to 5V Buck converter

nodes.name: power_3v3
nodes.description: AMS1117-3.3 LDO steps VCC_5V down to VCC_3V3 for MCU and Flash logic. Input and output require bypass capacitors for stability and transient response. This module distributes VCC_3V3 to all 3.3V logic components. No enable control pin available on this LDO variant (always-on when input powered).
5V to 3.3V LDO

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: STM32F103 Cortex-M3 MCU operating on VCC_3V3. UART1 connects to both TMC2209 drivers on shared half-duplex bus (drivers use different addresses configured via MS1_AD0/MS2_AD1 pins). SPI1 connects to W25Q64JV Flash for motion parameter storage. BOOT0 must be pulled low for Flash boot mode. NRST requires external pull-up and filter capacitor. HSE crystal configuration per application requirements. STEP/DIR GPIO outputs control motor motion. DIAG inputs receive fault feedback from drivers.
ARM Cortex-M3 MCU

nodes.name: stepper_driver_a
nodes.description: TMC2209 stepper motor driver channel A. VS_1/VS_2 pins connect to VIN_12V for motor power stage. VCC_IO pin connects to VCC_5V for logic interface level shifting. PDN_UART connects to shared UART bus with unique address configured via MS1_AD0/MS2_AD1 pins (address distinct from channel B). STEP/DIR inputs from MCU control motor motion. DIAG pin provides open-drain fault feedback to MCU. 5VOUT pin is an output that can supply regulated 5V to external circuitry if needed. VREF pin sets motor current limit via DAC or resistor divider. Motor outputs OA1/OA2/OB1/OB2 connect to stepper motor coil pair A. SPREAD pin configures chopper mode (spreadCycle vs stealthChop). ENN pin enables/disables motor outputs.
Stepper motor driver (channel A)

nodes.name: storage_flash
nodes.description: W25Q64JV 64Mbit SPI NOR Flash for non-volatile motion parameter storage. Operates on VCC_3V3. SPI interface (CS, DI, DO, CLK) connects to MCU. WP and HOLD pins tied to VCC to disable write protection and hold functions. Motion profiles, calibration data, configuration parameters, and firmware updates stored here. CS pin active-low for device selection.
